payload.description: The council does not publish a councillor's register at an ordinary web address. Each one sits behind a button on that councillor's page, which redirects to a signed address that then serves the file to anyone. Those addresses were resolved by hand, once, on 8 September 2026. The 17 readable ones were fetched and checked; the 22 scanned ones were not fetched, so their links are recorded as resolved but have not been opened by this project.

ai.reviewed_by: two independent AI review passes, reconciled against the source documents, 8 September 2026
